description: Validate a ui_cards payload (version bamf.ui_cards.v1) or a GenUI spec (v 1) with the exact rules BAMF's renderer uses. Returns format, valid, normalized (what BAMF will render, with invalid cards or nodes dropped) and errors with a path and message. Read-only and side-effect free: nothing is stored. To keep a validated spec, save the normalized JSON with bamf.save_agent_artifact after the user approves.

spec.description: A ui_cards payload or GenUI spec, as an object or JSON string.

name: bamf.validate_ui_spec
